instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot. In a gym with a circular logo on the grey padded wall, the shirtless man with a mullet (R2) lunges from the left, extending his right arm to throw a punch. The man in the black t-shirt (R1) stands on the right, facing left and raising his black-gloved hands to block the incoming strike. Both wear white shin guards and protective glasses. The gym is empty of other people, with camera tripods visible in the background. The lighting is even and neutral.
